device.model: USB microscope with UVC LED/FLC control
device.name: Dino-Lite UVC LED control (dinoliteuvccontrol.DinoLiteUVCControl)

facts.text: DinoLiteUVCControl enumerates USB devices with lsusb, filters vendor id a168, and creates Device0980 for product 0980 and Device0890 for product 0890 in ourDevices
The user constructs DinoLiteUVCControl(args) and reaches the microscopes through worker.ourDevices
led_on sends the UVC payload f2010000000000 to selector 4:2
led_off sends the UVC payload f2000000000000 to selector 4:2
flc_on sends f3010000000000 and flc_off sends f3000000000000 to selector 4:2
The 5 MP constructor starts the FLC brightness at 6, and led_dim and led_brighten move it one level at a time
toggle_led_1 through toggle_led_4 turn one of the four FLC LEDs off or on and refuse while FLC is off
toggle_auto_exposure turns auto exposure on or off with the UVC payloads 05070003357810 and 05000003357810
The 5 MP exposure settings run from 1/1000s to 16s and the default is key 7 (1/8s)
Exposure time can only be changed while auto exposure is off, and increase/decrease move one entry in the settings
The 1.2 MP model has no FLC: flc_on, flc_off, led_dim, led_brighten and toggle_led_1 through toggle_led_4 report that FLC is not available
The 1.2 MP model's LED on and off payloads are 8001f1 and 8001f0 on UVC selector 4:3
The 5 MP constructor turns FLC off and the main LED on at startup
The upstream cleanup() is pass and display_shutdown_message() exits the interpreter; neither is a device stop
Every uvcdynctrl call passes the video node with -d
uvcdynctrl must be installed on the host and this module calls it a lot
